objective: Make Company OS Claude execution truthfully measurable and radically more token-efficient without weakening developer quality, independent review, deterministic validation, integration readiness, authority boundaries, or CEO approval.
phase: Agent Context and Token Efficiency V4
authority_change: none; this sub-phase narrows execution under the existing Repository Architecture V1 contract
confirmed_baseline_findings: wo-delegation-planning-test-ownership-v2 developer stage launched two paid Claude sessions inside one Company OS developer attempt
developer session-1 stopped at error_max_budget_usd after USD 3.033953, 1,917,651 cache-read units, 85,218 cache-creation units, and 61,693 output units
developer session-2 succeeded after an additional USD 0.4383165, 194,273 cache-read units, 39,252 cache-creation units, and 3,832 output units
the developer-stage total was USD 3.4722695, 2,111,924 cache-read units, 124,470 cache-creation units, and 65,525 output units before reviewer usage
the repair SessionRequest omits max_cost, whose dataclass default is 0.0 meaning no provider spend ceiling
stage-level session.json and exploration.json are overwritten by a later internal repair session while session-N artifacts remain, allowing summaries to understate prior paid sessions
Claude system/init exposed many built-in tools plus the connected claude.ai Claude Docs MCP server even though the runner passed a narrow --allowedTools set
the installed CLI distinguishes --tools availability from --allowedTools permission and supports --strict-mcp-config; current binary support for other controls must be probed before use
p0_acceptance_criteria: every Claude subprocess launched within a stage is preserved as an individually attributable session and included in stage/job aggregate usage
receipts and efficiency reports cannot silently substitute the final repair session for total stage usage
a provider budget-stop outcome such as error_max_budget_usd cannot automatically trigger another paid model session
every explicitly authorized repair session preserves or tightens the original model, timeout, tool, and provider-cost ceilings
stage evidence states paid_session_count and aggregate cost, cache-read, cache-creation, output, input, and reliability metadata without imputing unavailable values
regression tests reproduce the historical two-session failure shape and fail against the old behavior
no production simulation code, canonical main, deployment, publishing, workforce activation, or CEO-reserved authority is changed
post_p0_experiments: isolated Claude startup using supported safe-mode or equivalent after auditing required worker instructions
actual tool-surface minimization using --tools in addition to permission controls
strict MCP isolation with no unrelated MCP servers in routine engineering sessions
hard model-turn circuit breaker where supported by the pinned Claude Code version
deterministic test execution outside the developer model with compact failure-only correction evidence
live stream resource guard if justified after static controls are measured
token-budgeted semantic context compiler using local deterministic indexing/ranking
reviewer evidence minimization while preserving independent judgment
quality_invariants: developer and reviewer remain separate model sessions when a model reviewer is required
review independence is not replaced by developer self-attestation
required deterministic tests and the full integration gate remain authoritative
no automatic merge, deploy, publish, tag, or canonical promotion
optimization is evaluated on total processed resources per accepted verified outcome, not prompt length alone
stop_conditions: do not run another paid Company OS Claude job until P0 acceptance criteria pass deterministically
stop an experiment if quality, authority, evidence integrity, or integration readiness regresses
do not add an external MCP or dependency merely because it claims token savings; prove a measured gap first
